# Change documentation

## Overview

Requirement: Create a short link for a valid HTTP/HTTPS address, redirect to the original address, and record redirect count and last redirect time.

Normalized: create a short link for a valid http https address redirect to the original address and record redirect count and last redirect time

Capabilities: [CREATE_LINK, REDIRECT, ANALYTICS]

## Behavior

- CREATE_LINK B1: a client can create a short link for an absolute http/https address with a non-empty host
- CREATE_LINK B2: other schemes (incl. javascript, file, data) are refused
- CREATE_LINK B3: localhost and literal loopback/private hosts are refused without name resolution
- CREATE_LINK B4: each code is unique, URL-safe, 7 characters, regenerated at most 5 times on collision
- CREATE_LINK B5: addresses up to 2,048 characters
- CREATE_LINK B6: storage unavailable means creation fails with service-unavailable and no code
- REDIRECT B1: an active link redirects to its original address
- REDIRECT B2: an unknown code returns not-found
- REDIRECT B3: storage unavailable means a redirect returns service-unavailable
- REDIRECT B4: an analytics-recording failure does not prevent the redirect
- ANALYTICS B1: each successful redirect increments the link's count and sets its last-redirect time, readable by clients
- ANALYTICS B2: not-found and expired attempts are not counted
- ANALYTICS B3: no count is lost under concurrent redirects

## API

- POST /api/links
- GET /r/{code}
- GET /api/links/{code}

## Data

- link table (V2__links.sql)
- link table (read)
- link.redirect_count, link.last_redirect_at

## Implementation
